segments.sn34.50:1.1: Sāvatthinidānaṃ …“samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī … samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī hoti, na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo … neva samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti, na ca samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī … samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca.
segments.sn34.50:1.6: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī … pe … uttamo ca pavaro cā”ti.
segments.sn34.51:1.1: Samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī … pe ….
segments.sn34.52:1.1: Samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī … pe ….
